label: Split Field
description: Split a field into a derived output.

fields.label: Custom delimiter
fields.help: Spaces count. Matched exactly, not as a pattern.

options.label: Keep one part
options.description: Write one part to an output column.

options.label: One record per part
options.description: Turn each part into its own record.

fields.label: Part to Keep
fields.help: A position counted from 1, or "last". Values with fewer parts give a blank.
Each part becomes its own record, replacing the field's value. The other columns are copied to every new record. Blank parts are dropped.

english.default: Split {{tableColumn param.source_file param.source_alias param.field_name}} on {{splitDelimiterName param}} and display part {{param.split_part}} in column {{quote (trim param.output_column)}}.

default.sql: {{#if (eq (splitPart param.split_part) "last")}}RIGHT({{field param.source_file param.field_name alias=param.source_alias}}, CHARINDEX(REVERSE({{quote (orEmpty (splitDelimiterChar param) (placeholder "delimiter" "[delimiter]"))}}), REVERSE({{quote (orEmpty (splitDelimiterChar param) (placeholder "delimiter" "[delimiter]"))}} + {{field param.source_file param.field_name alias=param.source_alias}})) - 1){{else if (eq (splitPart param.split_part) 1)}}LEFT({{field param.source_file param.field_name alias=param.source_alias}}, CHARINDEX({{quote (orEmpty (splitDelimiterChar param) (placeholder "delimiter" "[delimiter]"))}}, {{field param.source_file param.field_name alias=param.source_alias}} + {{quote (orEmpty (splitDelimiterChar param) (placeholder "delimiter" "[delimiter]"))}}) - 1){{else}}(SELECT [value] FROM STRING_SPLIT({{field param.source_file param.field_name alias=param.source_alias}}, {{quote (orEmpty (splitDelimiterChar param) (placeholder "delimiter" "[delimiter]"))}}, 1) WHERE [ordinal] = {{splitPart param.split_part}}){{/if}}

{{#if (eq param.split_by "width")}}df[{{quote (default (trim param.field_name) (placeholder "field" "[field]"))}}] = {{field param.source_file param.field_name alias=param.source_alias}}.fillna("").astype(str).map(lambda x: [x[i:i + {{splitWidth param.split_width}}] for i in range(0, len(x), {{splitWidth param.split_width}})] or [""])
df = df.explode({{quote (default (trim param.field_name) (placeholder "field" "[field]"))}}){{else}}df[{{quote (default (trim param.field_name) (placeholder "field" "[field]"))}}] = {{field param.source_file param.field_name alias=param.source_alias}}.fillna("").astype(str).str.split({{quote (orEmpty (splitDelimiterChar param) (placeholder "delimiter" "[delimiter]"))}}, regex=False)
df = df.explode({{quote (default (trim param.field_name) (placeholder "field" "[field]"))}})
